# Dependencies of the Linux release build (docker/Dockerfile). The same set as the top-level
# conanfile.txt minus libaec: HDF5 is built without szip here, and libaec's upstream
# (gitlab.dkrz.de) rate-limits CI downloads. libcurl (for VCell messaging) is built in the
# Dockerfile with CMake: conan's libcurl recipe needs autotools, whose conan m4 fails on this image.
[requires]
hdf5/[~1.14.5]
libzip/[~1.11.3]
zlib/[~1.2.11]

[options]
*:shared=False
hdf5/*:with_zlib=True
libzip/*:crypto=False
libzip/*:with_bzip2=False
libzip/*:with_lzma=False
libzip/*:with_zstd=False

[tool_requires]
cmake/[~3.31.6]
ninja/[~1.12.1]

[generators]
CMakeDeps
CMakeToolchain
